package ui

import "github.com/gsxhq/gsx" // fixture import comment must survive resolution

const unrelatedRecipeDocumentation = "recipe names belong only in canonical class expressions"

component Button(variant string, size string, href string, children gsx.Node, attrs gsx.Attrs) {
	{ if href != "" {
		<a
			class={
				"before inline-flex items-center middle sm:hover:[&>svg]:size-4",
				switch variant {
				case "outline":
					"border border-input bg-background"
				default:
					"bg-primary text-primary-foreground"
				},
				"between",
				switch size { case "icon": "size-9 [&>svg]:shrink-0" default: "h-9 px-4" },
				"after"
			} // Preserve this comment adjacent to the class switches.
			href={href}
			{ attrs... }
			data-gsxui-slot-button
		>
			{ children }
		</a>
	} else {
		<button
			class={
				"before inline-flex items-center middle sm:hover:[&>svg]:size-4",
				switch variant {
				case "outline":
					"border border-input bg-background"
				default:
					"bg-primary text-primary-foreground"
				},
				"between",
				switch size { case "icon": "size-9 [&>svg]:shrink-0" default: "h-9 px-4" },
				"after"
			} // Preserve this comment adjacent to the class switches.
			type="button"
			{ attrs... }
			data-gsxui-slot-button
		>
			{ children }
		</button>
	} }
}
